description: This PHP file contains utility functions related to testing and debugging for the TestLink API, including functions to display sample messages, run tests with debug information, and handle XML-RPC client interactions.
external_files: XML-RPC client object methods: query(), getErrorCode(), getErrorMessage(), getResponse()

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Displays an HTML message indicating how to access a sample database for testing the API.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a test call on the provided XML-RPC client, outputs debugging info if enabled, and returns the response.
